description: Saves prices found in stores to the SHARED price cache (used by all users). Only prices you saw on a store site of the country profile, with the product url; price per material unit from calculate_materials, in the country's currency. Never prices the user only told you. Invalid items come back in rejected with a reason.

source.description: Price source: type store_page|flyer|search|user|other, url, note

title: Save prices
